\documentclass[12pt,border=10pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{blogplot}
\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}
  % Left: continuous CDF F(y)=y^2, quantile Q(u)=sqrt(u).
  \begin{axis}[blog axis,name=left,width=7.6cm,height=7.6cm,
    xlabel={$y$},ylabel={$u$},
    xmin=0,xmax=1.05,ymin=0,ymax=1.08,
    xtick={0,0.5,1},xticklabels={$0$,$\frac12$,$1$},
    ytick={0,0.25,1},yticklabels={$0$,$\frac14$,$1$},
    title={$F(y)=y^2$},title style={font=\FigureLabelFont}]
    % bands: heights (1/4,1] and their image (1/2,1]
    \fill[figure halftone] (axis cs:0,0.25) rectangle (axis cs:0.04,1);
    \draw[line width=.5pt] (axis cs:0,0.25) rectangle (axis cs:0.04,1);
    \fill[figure halftone] (axis cs:0.5,0) rectangle (axis cs:1,0.04);
    \draw[line width=.5pt] (axis cs:0.5,0) rectangle (axis cs:1,0.04);
    \addplot[ink,line width=1.2pt,domain=0:1,samples=80,mark=none]{x^2};
    \draw[line width=1.6pt] (axis cs:0,0.25) -- (axis cs:0.5,0.25);
    \draw[figure emph arrow] (axis cs:0.5,0.25) -- (axis cs:0.5,0.05);
    \fill[ink] (axis cs:0.5,0.25) circle (2.4pt);
  \end{axis}
  % Right: die staircase CDF.
  \begin{axis}[blog axis,at={($(left.east)+(1.6cm,0)$)},anchor=west,
    width=7.6cm,height=7.6cm,
    xlabel={face},
    xmin=0.4,xmax=6.6,ymin=0,ymax=1.08,
    xtick={1,2,3,4,5,6},
    ytick={0,0.3,0.5,1},yticklabels={$0$,$.30$,$.50$,$1$},
]
    \fill[figure halftone] (axis cs:0.4,0.30) rectangle (axis cs:4,0.50);
    % flat steps
    \draw[ink,line width=1.2pt] (axis cs:0.4,0) -- (axis cs:1,0);
    \draw[ink,line width=1.2pt] (axis cs:1,0.05) -- (axis cs:2,0.05);
    \draw[ink,line width=1.2pt] (axis cs:2,0.15) -- (axis cs:3,0.15);
    \draw[ink,line width=1.2pt] (axis cs:3,0.3) -- (axis cs:4,0.3);
    \draw[ink,line width=1.2pt] (axis cs:4,0.5) -- (axis cs:5,0.5);
    \draw[ink,line width=1.2pt] (axis cs:5,0.7) -- (axis cs:6,0.7);
    \draw[ink,line width=1.2pt] (axis cs:6,1) -- (axis cs:6.6,1);
    % jumps (dotted risers), open bottom, closed top
    \draw[muted,dotted,line width=.6pt] (axis cs:1,0) -- (axis cs:1,0.05);
    \filldraw[ink] (axis cs:1,0.05) circle (2.2pt);
    \filldraw[draw=ink,fill=paper] (axis cs:1,0) circle (2.2pt);
    \draw[muted,dotted,line width=.6pt] (axis cs:2,0.05) -- (axis cs:2,0.15);
    \filldraw[ink] (axis cs:2,0.15) circle (2.2pt);
    \filldraw[draw=ink,fill=paper] (axis cs:2,0.05) circle (2.2pt);
    \draw[muted,dotted,line width=.6pt] (axis cs:3,0.15) -- (axis cs:3,0.3);
    \filldraw[ink] (axis cs:3,0.3) circle (2.2pt);
    \filldraw[draw=ink,fill=paper] (axis cs:3,0.15) circle (2.2pt);
    \draw[muted,dotted,line width=.6pt] (axis cs:5,0.5) -- (axis cs:5,0.7);
    \filldraw[ink] (axis cs:5,0.7) circle (2.2pt);
    \filldraw[draw=ink,fill=paper] (axis cs:5,0.5) circle (2.2pt);
    \draw[muted,dotted,line width=.6pt] (axis cs:6,0.7) -- (axis cs:6,1);
    \filldraw[ink] (axis cs:6,1) circle (2.2pt);
    \filldraw[draw=ink,fill=paper] (axis cs:6,0.7) circle (2.2pt);
    \draw[line width=2pt] (axis cs:4,0.30) -- (axis cs:4,0.50);
    \filldraw[ink] (axis cs:4,0.50) circle (2.2pt);
    \filldraw[draw=ink,fill=paper] (axis cs:4,0.30) circle (2.2pt);
    \draw[line width=1.6pt] (axis cs:0.4,0.42) -- (axis cs:4,0.42);
    \node[fill=paper,inner sep=1.5pt,font=\FigureNoteFont,anchor=south] at (axis cs:2.2,0.54) {$u=0.42$};
    \draw[figure emph arrow] (axis cs:4,0.42) -- (axis cs:4,0.04);
  \end{axis}
  \coordinate (nw) at (current bounding box.north west);
  \coordinate (se) at (current bounding box.south east);
  \draw[figure rule heavy] ($(nw)+(0,0.45)$) -- ($(se|-nw)+(0,0.45)$);
  \draw[figure rule thin] ($(nw)+(0,0.31)$) -- ($(se|-nw)+(0,0.31)$);
  \draw[figure rule heavy] ($(se-|nw)+(0,-0.3)$) -- ($(se)+(0,-0.3)$);
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
